The only runner, mac, drives mac-mars-usb10g, and that link has no host for netem delay or a CPU cap; no development case is opened, since the gaps have not reproduced at home and engineering.can_open is false. mac instead runs one cheap step-1 check after MM1 finishes: does lab2's exact build 0c94b3d70b9d with -a -j4 lose ground on small trees compared with e51c1df1329a, the build every home reproduction has used, and with -j2 (lab2's vCPU count) compared with -j4?

Only mixed-bimodal and small-flat have measured sample times on this link. One experiment of about 24 min checks an untested confound behind both lab2 gaps: lab2 runs 0c94b3d70b9d, while all home reproductions (L2R1 to L2R8) used e51c1df1329a. It deliberately repeats only lab2's fresh scenario with lab2's flags, so it does not duplicate MM1's baseline sweep.
